completionNarrative: The test suite now passes completely (464/464 tests across 39 files). The defect was in `src/chess.ts`: the `Move.isCapture()` method used `>= -1` instead of `> -1` in its return condition, causing it to always return `true` regardless of whether a move was actually a capture. All other similar methods (`isPromotion()`, `isEnPassant()`, etc.) correctly used `> -1`. The fix was a one-character change from `>=-1` to `>-1`.
